body:
**Disclosure: The code for this mod was 100% AI generated.**

A fully client-side mod that automatically scans your inventory and displays every item you are currently able to craft.

- **Click = 1 craft**
- **Shift+Click = 1 stack craft**
- **Ctrl+Shift+Click = Mass Craft** (config for speed)
- **Right Click = Variants list and missing items**

![Recipe book tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54a230e1827db405d28fc2f4b968ec9a88870a3b.png)

![Variants list](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/631a2e314484b7b25f3d233dcd26500e5e60e345.png)

![Missing items in craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c5128e3ef4c8ca02873ebedeab254dba7ec8f4e.png)

This mod was entirely based on the old "Crafting Table III" mod by Zeldo.

I might not be very fast with updates to this mod and would love for a true programmer to take the torch and make this mod so much better. ♥️
